messages.text: Hi Ramesh 👋 This is Revnyx Agent reaching out on behalf of ClearTax. We noticed your ₹4,999 invoice payment is 3 days overdue.
Oh yes I forgot, can you send me the link?
Sure! Here's your secure payment link valid for 24 hours: pay.cleartax.in/inv-2841 💳
✅ Payment confirmed! Your invoice is now cleared. Thank you, Ramesh!
Hi Priya, we noticed your Asianet broadband usage has dropped significantly over the past 2 weeks. Is everything okay with your connection?
Speeds have been slow lately tbh
I'm sorry to hear that. Our tech team has flagged an issue in your area — it's being resolved by tonight. As a courtesy, we'd like to offer you 10GB bonus data. Shall I apply it?
Done! 10GB bonus data added to your account 🎁 You'll receive an SMS confirmation shortly.
Hi Arjun! You explored edForce's Data Analytics course last week. Many learners from your profile land roles at ₹8–12L within 6 months. Would you like to connect with our advisor?
Of course! Worth noting: the next cohort starts May 15 and early joiners get a ₹5,000 scholarship. I can hold a seat for you until tomorrow — want me to?
